why: The sales invoice workflow: draft save/post, the invoice event, GL and COGS posting, FIFO cost of sold items, stock restore on cancel, cancel/void and document numbers. The sales and sale_items tables stay in core: customer and partner receivables, reconciliation, payments and partner merge read sales (some from SQL functions that need the table when they are created), and inventory costing (inventory_batch_consumptions), cut sheets (polywood_pieces) and customer AR use sale_items. The sales table's triggers and the stock functions they call stay in core with it.
